thread:
nora: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 wording around audit log retention, PII redaction timing, and customer KMS options: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
ash: Nice. One immediate ask from legal: avoid 'indefinite' anywhere and state the default retention numerically. Can we say 90 days as default?
leah: Ops chiming in: Dedicated deployments allow per-tenant retention overrides via the ops console; we should include a short migration note for existing Dedicated customers who may want to keep longer logs. Link to /dedicated/ops/retention.md would help.
nora: Added: "Default audit log retention is 90 days. Enterprise customers may contract for extended retention up to 7 years." Put the Dedicated migration callout under a bold note.
ash: Also, the PII language was a bit strong. We don't fully redact before any processing. Suggest: "We run automated PII detection during ingestion; identified PII is masked before long-term storage. Transient processing buffers may contain unmasked tokens for short-lived compute workloads; these are encrypted and access-controlled."
leah: Good. Add a tiny SDK example showing how customers can opt into reduced logging for dev/testing:
```js
// opt-out of request audit logs for local dev
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { audit: { enabled: false } } });
```
infra-bot: docs-ci: lint OK for PR #912  warnings: frontmatter missing 'productArea'.
nora: I'll add the frontmatter and tweak wording: clarified KMS sentence to read "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Private and Dedicated deployments; Hosted customers default to Redwood-managed keys unless a customer-managed key arrangement is specified in contract."
ash: Can we also add a one-liner about auditor access flow? Legal wants: support ticket + SOW, time-limited, and auditor actions are logged.
leah: Done in the PR as a bullet. Also suggested an ops contact for Dedicated migrations.
nora: Great. After legal approves retention numbers I'll merge. Thanks for the quick reviews.
leah: Thx. Leaving a note to follow up with support to prep the SOW template.
ash: LGTM once legal signs off. :thumbsup:
